summary: Implemented the postflight completion-deploy gate: a check-only, unconditional exit-6 backstop in update-task-status.sh refusing completion while a source-store-touching task's deploy is provably stale, with two serialized baseline-relative redeploy triggers (single-task and multi-task), the mandatory carve-out, and a shared freshness library. All 8 plan phases COMPLETED, deployed, and self-demonstrated against this task's own completion.

artifacts.summary: 8-phase implementation of the postflight completion-deploy gate: shared freshness library, check-only exit-6 backstop in update-task-status.sh, regression suite, two serialized baseline-relative deploy triggers, the mandatory carve-out, and a deployed, dogfooded self-demonstration.
